results.title: KLCC REIT Appoints Former KPMG Chief Datuk Johan Idris As Independent Director
results.description: KLCC Real Estate Investment Trust (KLCC REIT) has appointed corporate leader and former KPMG Malaysia Managing Partner Datuk Johan Idris as an Independent Non-Executive Director, effective Aug 1, 2026. Johan, 60, currently serves as Non-Executive Chairman of KPMG Malaysia and is also Chairman of Maxis Berhad, in addition to chairing Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia (UKM). His [...]

results.title: Plea for adequate staffing for Armagh City, Banbridge & Craigavon Borough cemeteries
results.description: Councillor Julie Flaherty has praised the Blitz Team and other maintenance staff for the excellent work they have carried out in recent times at Kernan Cemetery, however she has expressed concerns over future service provision, against the backdrop of staff shortages.
